abstract: To explore the etiology of testicular cancer, cases of testicular cancer were identified among members of a cohort of Danish boys born between 1941 and 1957 (inclusive), who had attended schools in Copenhagen and Gentofte and whose school health records were contained in an archive under the supervision of the Danish Cancer Registry. One hundred and eighty-three cases of testicular cancer diagnosed before 31 December 1984 were identified; 366 controls, matched to cases by sex and age, were selected from the same cohort. Information on potential risk factors and confounders was obtained from two sources: school health records and midwife protocols, both of which were recorded prior to the diagnosis of testicular cancer in cases. Relative risks (RR) approximated by the odds ratios were calculated and, in logistic regression analyses, adjustments were done for known or suspected confounders. A decreasing risk of testicular cancer with increasing birth order was observed (P = 0.020). Compared with being firstborn, being number four or more in birth order was associated with a significantly decreased RR for all testicular cancers (RR = 0.3, 95 percent confidence interval [CI] = 0.3-0.8) and testicular seminoma (RR = 0.1, CI = 0.02-0.9). No association was observed between high social class and the risk of testicular cancer (RR = 1.4, CI = 0.8-2.3); neither was age at which the study subjects had mumps or measles related to risk of testicular cancer. No cases of mumps orchitis were observed before or during school years. A slightly increased RR for testicular cancer among boys from small families could be explained by the association between family size and birth order.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: 精巣がんの病因を探るため、1941年から1957年に生まれ、コペンハーゲンおよびゲントフテの学校に通い、学校健康記録がデンマークがん登録の監督下にある公文書館に保管されているデンマークの男児コホートの成員の中から、精巣がんの症例を同定した。1984年12月31日以前に診断された精巣がん183例が同定された。性別と年齢で症例とマッチさせた対照366例を同コホートから選択した。潜在的な危険因子と交絡因子に関する情報は、症例の精巣がん診断前に記録された学校健康記録と助産師の記録の2つの情報源から得た。相対リスク（オッズ比で近似）を算出し、既知または疑われる交絡因子で調整したロジスティック回帰分析を行った。出生順位が高くなるほど精巣がんのリスクが低下することが認められた（P = 0.020）。第1子と比較して出生順位が第4子以上の場合、精巣がん全体（RR = 0.3、95%信頼区間 0.3–0.8）および精巣セミノーマ（RR = 0.1、CI = 0.02–0.9）の相対リスクが有意に低かった。高い社会階級と精巣がんのリスクとの関連は認められず（RR = 1.4、CI = 0.8–2.3）、研究対象者が流行性耳下腺炎または麻疹に罹患した年齢も、精巣がんのリスクとは関連していなかった。学齢期以前または学齢期中に流行性耳下腺炎性精巣炎の症例は認められなかった。小家族における精巣がんリスクのわずかな上昇は、家族の規模と出生順位との関連によって説明できる可能性がある。（抄録は250語で打ち切られている）
